en: This is a vintage black and white postcard depicting a street scene with several multi-story apartment buildings featuring balconies and decorative rooftops. The street is sloped and cobblestone, and there are a few people walking or sitting outside. In the background, water and a shoreline are visible. The top of the postcard includes text in both Swedish and Finnish languages, identifying the location.
